verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers Azure CLI, IaC tools (Bicep/ARM/Terraform), RBAC, cost management, and pricing/status pages, but contains no mention of a first-party managed agent runtime or orchestration service (e.g., an Azure AI Foundry Agent Service) being shipped or documented. The MCP reference (azure-probe-4) is a tool-server integration, not an agent runtime/orchestration home. Missing for 10: any documented first-party agent runtime, orchestration engine, agent lifecycle management, or hosted agent service with docs/APIs.
